collection: Capas del armado de hamburguesas y papas de Purple
method: ImageGen integrado generó siete láminas RGBA de 1024 × 1536, con tres ingredientes separados por lámina. Se compararon sus formas, color y disposición con las fotografías de la carta y las ilustraciones de ingredientes existentes. Cada PNG aislado se exportó con alfa conservado a WebP responsivo y a un maestro WebP de 3840 px de lado mayor por interpolación Lanczos. Estos recortes ilustran la composición de las recetas. La geometría se reconstruye en unidades relativas al diámetro del pan, con mallas cerradas y textura frontal.
geometry: Bollos y recipiente tienen perfiles de revolución cerrados; el recipiente incluye cara interior, pared, labio y base. Las otras capas se reconstruyen con intersecciones de rayos sobre secciones superelípticas a 12° y se cierran alrededor de la silueta y sus huecos. Todas las mallas se centran en los tres ejes. El eje vertical es Y. La cara fotografiada mira hacia +Z. Width es diámetro horizontal, depth es el fondo físico y thickness es el alto físico. Height es la altura de proyección a 12°. stackAdvance describe el alto físico que consume cada pieza una vez asentada.

bread.prompt: Create an editorial PHOTO ASSET CONTACT SHEET of exactly THREE SEPARATE isolated edible objects / layers, ONE in each of three clear horizontal rows from TOP to BOTTOM in a PORTRAIT 2:3 frame, true alpha transparent background. Invisible baseline. Three objects stacked vertically in the sheet, with at least 8% completely transparent space separating successive rows and all outer edges clear. Each object is horizontally centered, uses 83–90% of the canvas WIDTH, 80–100 mm as if for the same Colombian smash burger, and photographed in exactly the same straight-on orientation: long axis horizontal, camera in front only 12 degrees above the table, very slightly visible top, for an exploded burger viewer. Make each item a cohesive ONE ACTUAL HORIZONTAL LAYER high-end advertising macro, natural tasty textures, detailed side edge, soft upper-left light, subtle shading under folds, distinguishable silhouette, food at its natural Z-height. Do not place on a surface: no shadow outside the individual objects, no ground plane, props, labels, lettering, or drawn separators. Nothing touches another row or the image edges. No sandwiches, plates, brands, steam, hands, floating debris or extra food. The three subjects must be fully visible, separate, appetizing, detailed and realistic. The reference collage is the ACTUAL restaurant's products and textures: ignore layout and any text. Row 1 top: ONLY the matching TOP crown of Purple's smooth light-to-dark golden shiny brioche bun, quite low rounded dome, delicate puffed irregularities and two short natural cracks, NO sesame, evenly baked tan edge, broadest width near its flat bottom, pale cut edge very subtly visible at base. Width roughly 3 times its physical height, tempting amber gloss. Row 2 middle: ONLY the BOTTOM HEEL of that same brioche, flat low cylinder with tawny porous sides, thin darker golden base, level, pale toasted buttered cut face looking upward, crust height a quarter of the crown height. Row 3 bottom: ONLY ONE cooked smash beef patty, broad thin irregular diameter, deep brown Maillard crust, peppered tiny jags and fine crispy lacelike edges, naturally juicy front edge, center thick and natural. Absolutely no cheese, sauces, buns or onions on the meat. The heel and beef are each presented largely edge-on with a little top visible, shaped like broad horizontal ellipses. Actual food photographs.
